description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableEntityInterceptor class, specifically testing behavior related to entity modification constraints within the OpenMRS core project. It verifies that immutable entities cannot be altered once flagged, with special handling for entities marked as voided or retired.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityInterceptorTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableEntityInterceptor, containing multiple test cases to enforce immutability constraints on entities.

classes.name: SomeImmutableEntityInterceptor
classes.description: A subclass of ImmutableEntityInterceptor used within tests to simulate support for Order class entities and test different scenarios involving mutable and immutable properties.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldFailIfAnEntityHasAChangedProperty
methods.description: Test that ensures an exception is thrown when attempting to modify an immutable property.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldPassIfAnEntityHasChangesForAnAllowedMutableProperty
methods.description: Test that verifies modification of mutable properties is permitted.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldFailIfTheEditedObjectIsVoidedOrRetiredAndIgnoreIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Test that verifies an exception is thrown if attempting to modify an immutable entity that is voided or retired when ignoring such states is disabled.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldPassIfTheEditedObjectIsVoidedOrRetiredAndIgnoreIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Test that modification of a voided or retired entity is allowed when ignoring such states.
